text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a few days before the academy's
tryouts, an event where students
can
demonstrate their skills to trainers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head over to the track to see how the
racers are doing today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm outta here. Catch ya guys later.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Vodka?! Where do you think you're
going?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh, she's such a wannabe delinquent!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
I'm concerned for her... I know she's got
the talent, but tryouts are
coming up. Will
she be okay?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh uh, you don't need to worry about her
performance. She'll be just
fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we just go ahead and start
practicing? The other students
are waiting
for your directions.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Well then,
let's get started,
shall we? We'll begin with a
2000-meter
jog.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the upcoming tryouts, Vodka
seems to be boycotting
practice today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curious, I follow her to figure out why.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. "Until you all find a trainer,
you'll
be following the instructors'
training
regimen!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: As if I have time for that generic crap!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do things my own way!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Who are... Oh, you're one of the
academy's trainers.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got a problem? I'm a lone wolf, and
that means I don't mingle.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the teacher's plans are waaaay
too chill for me. My body'll
get weaker at
that rate.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we're done, right? I'm gonna go
do my thing now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka bluntly ends the conversation and
walks off. I hang around for
a bit more,
observing her training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Pheeeew!
Now that's what I'm talkin' 'bout!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But I'm just gettin' started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though she's overloading in certain
aspects of her training and neglecting
others,
she's still going strong in her own
way.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, still here? Damn, you must have
nothin' better to do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What? Me? Skip training? Do I look that
lame?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, I'm gonna be the coolest racer
in the Twinkle Series, the
kind who leaves
everyone in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If I do the same as everyone else, then I'll be the same as everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's just like gettin' buried in the
middle of
the pack. You get stuck in
there with no
way out.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna train harder—so I can be faster
than everyone else! I'm not
gonna get
stuck behind anyone!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yep. Got a problem?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although boycotting her teacher's regimen
and creating her own
haphazard one isn't
the best course of action, she's got guts.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, whatcha doin' starin' at me like
that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Coo—?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-ahem! Sorry, can ya say that again? I
couldn't hear ya!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ya said somethin' 'bout me right? C'mon,
say it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's with that weak answer? Put
some oomph into it!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What did ya call me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! You've got a good eye for things!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna keep training...
but you can stick
around for as long as ya
want!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Because I'm so cool and generous!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right,
I'm pumped! Let's up those reps!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch her train with even more gusto,
I can't help but grin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, tryouts officially begin
and Vodka makes her
appearance.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Vodka is pushing ahead! Vodka is pushing
ahead! Daiwa Scarlet is
fighting with all
her might...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But the gap is too big! Vodka finishes in
first, Daiwa Scarlet in
second!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Your running's a bit rough around the
edges, but you've got great
potential,
Vodka! Why don't you come and join me?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
No, come join me instead! I've amassed
plenty of data on the racers
I've trained in the past.
I'll be able to design a training program
specifically for—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I'm not interested that kinda
thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's performance pulls in many
scouting offers, but none seem to
land.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you from the other day! Hehe,
whatd'ya think about my
racing?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: For real?! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, you're not training anyone yet,
right? How 'bout joining
forces with me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Looking forward to workin' with
ya, Trainer!
